notes: Taḥwīl: the first two branches meet at the tail («حدثنا أبي» is حفص بن غياث, a relation); the tail is written once after them, so it closes the first two groups

The third isnad («قال الأعمش وحدثني مسلم») follows the first with the same saying: a route of its own, written in full, not part of the tail; occurrences 1 and 2 separate the two Amash and two Aisha tokens
«- واللفظ له -» is a wording gloss, left out
